text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The news that Symboli Rudolf would step 
down from the front lines to work behind 
the scenes sent shockwaves through the 
public.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, we sat down with Symboli Rudolf 
and URA staff to hold serious discussions 
regarding the Overseas Expedition Program, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The meeting gradually grew stormy between 
those opposed to and those in favor of 
Sirius Symboli's overseas challenge.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having declared she would show results in 
a single year, Sirius Symboli decided to 
keep winning races to secure the necessary 
funds.
